title: Train Journeys for Sleep
description: Real train timetables read out gently. Authentic station names, departure times, and route details to drift off to.
vibe: Platform announcements at 3am. The 14:23 to York reads out calling points while the seats are empty and the carriage sways. Contemplative, rhythmic, real.
rhythm: Slow, regular, hypnotic. Each station announcement beats like a wheel on track joints.

audio_style.primary: TTS announcer reading station names and times
audio_style.pacing: ~90 WPM, unhurried, with soft pauses between stops

voice.style: Warm, clear, measured. Like a pleasant station announcer at 3am. No rush, no excitement. The voice of someone who has announced the same platform a thousand times and finds it mildly interesting still.

standard_class.visual: Standard carriage interior, rows of seats, window view of passing countryside
standard_class.ambiance: Rhythmic wheel-on-track sound, occasional brake squeal, gentle sway
standard_class.vibe: The late-night service. Half-empty carriage. The announcer's voice echoes slightly. You watch the dark countryside pass.

first_class.visual: Wider seats, table between facing seats, reading lights, quieter carriage
first_class.ambiance: Muted wheel sound, soft HVAC hum, the occasional page turn
first_class.vibe: The premium carriage. Leather seats. A single reading light. The announcer is more polite here, almost whispering.

sleeper.visual: Private compartment, bunk beds, small window, dim lighting
sleeper.ambiance: Near silence. The wheels are a distant rhythm. The heater clicks on and off.
sleeper.vibe: The Caledonian Sleeper. Your own compartment. The train rocks you to sleep. The announcer is a voice from another world.

data_sources.name: National Rail Enquiries
data_sources.format: Web — timetables, station names, calling points
